title: SWITCH with a string result and a number result

source.quote: By using TRUE as a first argument, SWITCH can replace a list of cascading IF statements.
source.supports: SWITCH is the same as nested IF functions

source.quote: The IF function can return a variant data type if value_if_true and value_if_false are of different data types
source.supports: IF with branches of different types returns a variant

source.quote: The following statement returns an error because the data types in the result arguments are different.
source.supports: the SWITCH page says results of different types are an error

derivation: Read as nested IF functions, which return a variant when the branches differ: n = 1 gives "one", n = 2 gives the integer 2, n = 3 matches nothing and is BLANK.
alternative: The Microsoft SWITCH page says that results of different data types are an error (its example is SWITCH ( [Class], "L", "Large", "H", 0.1 ) in a calculated column). If that holds for a query too, this query fails with an error.
